title: A Second-Logarithm Lower Bound for Sets with No Unique Sums
summary: For an odd prime $p$, let $m(p)$ be the minimum cardinality of a set $A\subseteq \mathbb Z/p\mathbb Z$, with $|A|\geq2$, such that no sum in $A+A$ has a unique representation as an unordered pair from $A$, with repetition allowed.
